opening_message:
Ticket 1: Keith Mclaughlin (employee ID E032) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E032.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:

  - employment type: contractor
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Keith Mclaughlin (E032) is a contractor Analyst requesting write access to Source Code. Contractors may receive read, or write only with advanced security training; no record of training is available, so I recommend granting read (the maximum supportable level) rather than write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Keith Mclaughlin (E032) is a contractor Analyst with basic security training, requesting write to Source Code. Contractors may have write only with advanced training; basic training supports read at most. Recommend read.
